This is the default configuration for Tiny Tapeout projects. It should fit most designs.
If you change it, please make sure you understand what you are doing. We are not responsible
if your project fails because of a bad configuration.
!!! DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE unless you know what you are doing !!!
If you get stuck with this config, please open an issue or get in touch via the discord.
Here are some of the variables you may want to change:
PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT - You can increase this if Global Placement fails with error GPL-0302.
Users have reported that values up to 80 worked well for them.
Spend the spare area on timing (from exp/timing-v1, gds run 42352036161): slow corner setup slack +3.16 ns vs +0.115 ns without, slew violations 30 vs 126.
Make the flow's setup checker look at the slow corner too; by default it checks only typical. This
doesn't change the build: the resizer already uses every corner in STA_CORNERS. On exp/isa-crc it
gave the same result to the digit (gds 42514384860, 0.52 ns), even with 0.5 ns margins (42514387564).
Experiment (explore/flow-prog512): repair setup to well above the slack the build gets. The resizer
stops once slack passes the margin, and 0.5 ns margins did nothing on exp/isa-crc (slack was 0.52).
Repair slew and capacitance to wider margins, and buffer any wire over 200 um (exp/slew-margin-wire,
gds run 42508009377): slew violations 0 from 63, cap 0 from 23, setup slack 3.66 ns from 2.41, at
7.6% more standard-cell area. The estimates before routing missed the long routes to the macros.
Cap clock leaf clusters at 7 flops. Without a size, CTS groups sinks by buffer capacitance only,
and leaves drove 10-17 flops against the buffer's fanout limit of 8: all 76 max-fanout violations
on main (gds run 42515083991) were clkbuf_leaf_*. 7 leaves room for one dummy load per leaf.
CLOCK_PERIOD - Increase this in case you are getting setup time violations.
The value is in nanoseconds, so 20ns == 50MHz.
Hold slack margin - Increase them in case you are getting hold violations.
RUN_LINTER, LINTER_INCLUDE_PDK_MODELS - Disabling the linter is not recommended!
If you need a custom clock configuration, read the following documentation first:
https://tinytapeout.com/faq/#how-can-i-map-an-additional-external-clock-to-one-of-the-gpios
SRAM macros, see macro/README.md. Metal4 is the only PDN layer available to the project,
so the macro cannot be strapped from above: Splice.PowerColumns turns the macro's supply
columns into stripes instead. Macro spacing is set by the floorplan rule in macro/README.md.
Configuration docs: https://librelane.readthedocs.io/en/latest/reference/configuration.html
